items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Teddy took some of the guys from Benny's band, because they were there, and there was Harry James on trumpet, Gene Krupa on drums, and Teddy Wilson.

ctx.x: Do you remember if Teddy played on that date? Did you do it with him?
Yes. Teddy took some of the guys from Benny's band, because they were there, and there was Harry James on trumpet, Gene Krupa on drums, and Teddy Wilson.
